noThemes: data.layoutTheme must be a layout asset id
data.colorTheme must be a color-theme asset id
data.styleTheme must be a style-theme asset id
never: data.assets.uac-policy: a skin never sets uac-policy here
data.assets.layout: a skin never sets layout here
badExtras: data.extras.spacing must be tight, compact or regular
data.extras.hidden must map asset types to true / false

table.label: Badge
table.why: a widget or attachable type with no style target (schemas/customize.json targets)

table.label: Help
table.why: excluded from appearance slots and not declared (add "skin": { "by": … } to its registry entry)

table.label: Mystery
table.why: mystery: skin.by must be one of slot, parts, reference, bundle, none

bad: data.parts.nope: not a registered asset type
data.parts.badge: this type has no style target, so a skin can't style its parts
data.parts.label must be an object (token → value)
notObject: data.parts must be an object (asset type → style parts)

declarationErrors: mystery: skin.by must be one of slot, parts, reference, bundle, none

covers.why: behaviour unset: press, confirm, confirmBy, holdMs

declarationErrors: broken.behaviour.bad: a choice axis needs at least two values (lower-case words)
broken.behaviour.bad: default must be one of its values
broken.behaviour.Bad Name: an axis name is a camelCase word (letters and digits, 40 at most)
broken.behaviour.num: a number axis needs min < max
broken.behaviour.num: default must be a number inside min..max
broken.behaviour.viaNowhere: of "nope" is not a registered asset type
broken.behaviour.odd: kind must be one of choice, switch, number

bad: data.behaviour.tab-group.overflow must be one of scroll, wrap, more
data.behaviour.mystery: not a registered asset type
data.behaviour.dialog must be an object (axis → value)
notObject: data.behaviour must be an object (asset type → axis → value)

behaviour.description: skin@2: a behaviour pick per asset type with behaviour (axes declared on the registry entry; unset = the asset's field, else today's behaviour)

position.description: Where tab rows sit (default "top"; unset = the asset's position)

placement.description: Where the toolbar goes (default "top"; unset = the layout's toolbarPosition)

stickyHeader.description: Sticky header (default true; unset = the asset's stickyHeader)

skin2Errors: data.behaviour.banner.placement must be one of top, bottom
data.behaviour.nope: not a registered asset type
data.behaviour.tab-group must be an object (axis → value)
